response.justification: Strong senior full-stack profile with well over the required 6+ years, including recent TypeScript/Node.js product work, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and direct AI-agent/MCP tooling experience that maps precisely to a listed requirement. Deep testing culture (TDD, authored a test runner and assertion library, Selenium coursework) and a CS degree round out the core qualifications. Main gaps are the absence of explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, and Kotlin experience, plus a notably fragmented job history with many overlapping short engagements — but the breadth and polyglot depth make these low-risk, interview-worthy questions rather than disqualifiers.
strengths: 15+ years across the stack with recent TypeScript/Node/React/AWS delivery
Hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling experience, a rare listed requirement
Exceptional testing/craftsmanship track record (TDD, CI/CD, authored test tooling)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Kotlin experience listed
Frontend/React depth appears lighter than backend and infra work
Fragmented, heavily overlapping job history with short recent tenure

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js, Vitest, and Kotlin specifics
